title: The Use of Amber Glasses in Improving Sleep
brief_summary: The use of amber glasses will aid the patient to fall asleep without the need for the use of hypnotic medication.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age over 18 years
* Male or female gender
* Presentation of mental illness (of psychotic nature, severe depression or anxiety)
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient does not consent
* High risk assessment of self-harm or harm to others
